title: The 18 Best Movies We Saw at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival
summary: Hear from IndieWire staffers and contributors about the best of the fest, from Palme d'Or winner "Fjord" to "Paper Tiger."

title: Clint Eastwood Gave Luke Grimes His Big Break — with ‘Marshals,’ the Actor Pays Tribute to Eastwood’s ‘Unforgiven’
summary: The star of the hit "Yellowstone" spinoff talks about how Eastwood's "American Sniper" led to his role as Kayce Dutton, why being a father has given him a deeper perspective on his character, and the autonomy that comes with playing the same character for dozens of hours.

title: The Cannes Awards Reveal Likely 2027 Oscar Contenders
summary: Neon won its seventh Palme d'Or with "Fjord," which will automatically vie for Best International Feature. With no American winners, which countries will submit the other prize-winners?

title: Cannes Film Festival Winners List: Palme d’Or Goes to ‘Fjord,’ Neon’s Seventh in a Row
summary: It's also writer/director Cristian Mungiu's second Palme after winning in 2007 for "4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days."

title: Why ‘Navalny’ Oscar Winner Daniel Roher Moved to Fiction for the Crowdpleasing ‘Tuner’
summary: The romantic thriller wowed audiences on the fall festival circuit and marks the emergence of an assured filmmaker, who tells us about the film, and a star in Leo Woodall.

title: Cannes 2026 Movies Sold So Far: Netflix Acquires ‘Gentle Monster’ Starring Léa Seydoux
summary: The Marie Kreutzer-directed drama is Netflix's third Cannes buy after the animated "In Waves" and Spanish epic "The Black Ball."

title: Sex, Politics, and ‘Star Wars’: How Disney’s $4 Billion Fandom Turned Socially Radioactive — Opinion
summary: Lucasfilm’s mishandling of the “Star Wars” sequel trilogy didn’t create fandom radicalization, but it did let women become scapegoats for a film culture that was already crumbling.

title: How to Make a Soundtrack Album for a TV Show
summary: Music supervisors Manish Raval, Tom Wolfe, and Jonathan Leahy tell IndieWire about taking a more holistic approach to the music of "Nobody Wants This" Season 2.

title: At Cannes, Filmmakers Explain How They Find Mainstream Funding for Culturally Specific Stories
summary: At the Local to Global Storytelling Panel presented by Gold House, producers and directors spoke about the challenges that come with finding funding for international stories.

title: ‘The Birthday Party’ Review: A Dazzlingly Melancholy Monica Bellucci Powers Léa Mysius’ Predictable but Superbly Directed Home Invasion Thriller
summary: A birthday celebration turns into hell on Earth in this tensely crafted thriller where the production values elevate conventional material.

title: ‘Once Upon a Time in Harlem’: Why William Greaves Didn’t Finish What He Considered His Most Important Film
summary: Cannes: The groundbreaking director believed the 1972 Harlem Renaissance gathering was the best thing he’d ever shot, but his son David discusses finishing the film after he died.

title: Why Director Boots Riley Embraced ‘Jankiness’ and an Indie Spirit to Make ‘I Love Boosters’
summary: Writer and director Boots Riley tells IndieWire why "pulling a Peter Greenaway" is important to creating the visual stories he wants to tell.
